verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents exposing specific TCP ports on a sandbox so external clients can reach web servers, dev servers, or other services inside it. Its preview URLs render an application live from a running sandbox, with optional auth (token-gated private URLs) and custom domains. missing for 10: an explicit documented step mapping a given port to a public preview URL (the docs only show this in summary form), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a port from the sandbox on a public preview URL to reach services running inside

citations.quote: Expose specific TCP ports on a Blaxel sandbox so external clients can connect to web servers, dev servers, or other services running inside it.
Render an application in real-time through a direct preview URL backed by a running Blaxel sandbox, with optional auth and custom domains.
When you create a private preview URL a token is required to access the URL.
